Packaging and storage architecture has evolved significantly from tvOS 13.4.8 to tvOS 26.6.1. The earlier version used unencrypted APFS rootfs within a MobileAsset OTA zip and relied on legacy frameworks. The later version utilizes a full restore IPSW, employing an AEA1 encrypted rootfs container secured with HPKE key exchange and leveraging newer frameworks for streaming disk images.


 tvOS 26.6.1 introduces a sealed system volume (SSV) with root hash, coupled with hardware trustcaches, for secure system integrity compared to the older version. The UI resolution and rendering system now handles a comprehensive resolution ladder with dedicated assets for different resolutions, indicating a significant improvement in visual fidelity. The shell compositor (PineBoard.app) remains the master but has been restructured to support modular control centers, multi-user profiles, and interactive modals, representing a shift towards greater modularity and advanced functionality.


 tvOS 26.6.1 integrates platform applications such as FaceTime (Continuity Camera), Sing (Apple Music), PosterBoard (Lock Screen customization), and Fitness (Apple Fitness+ with Apple Watch metrics). Objective-C has been replaced by a deep Swift migration across system libraries, including Combine, CryptoKit, and DriverKit.

The focus engine has also evolved from a 2D spatial `UIFocusEngine` to a dual-stack approach bridging `UIFocusItem` and SwiftUI `@FocusState`, enabling enhanced navigation within complex layouts.
